<entry id="A02204">

<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (of אנטל; from which Greek ἄντλος, ἄντλον &c. and our w. ἄντλεία, antlia) 
<italic>baling out bilge-water, pump</italic> (with wheels and buckets).</definition>
<notes> Ruth R. to II, 19 גלגל אנטי'; Lev. R. s. 34 אנטל' (ed. אנטילא, corr. acc.) the pumping wheel. Tosef. Makhsh. III, 4 מפני א' שלהן on account of their baling machine (besprinkling the wheat). Ib. Mikv. IV, 2 אנטיליא.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="A02216">
<head-word>אני, </head-word>

<italic>Pi.</italic> (אִנָּה) אִינָּה 
<italic>to press, wrong, oppress; to impose, overreach in dealing</italic>, v. 
<xref rid="A00722">אֹונָאָה</xref>.</definition>
<notes> B. Mets. 59
<sup>b</sup> המְאַנֶּה את הגר he who wounds a stranger’s (proselyte’s) feeling. Ib. 49
<sup>b</sup> תן לי מה שאִינִּיתָנִי return to me the amount with which thou hast overreached me. Ib. 50
<sup>a</sup> top מה שאניתני (Ms. R. 1 שנִתְאֹונַנְתִּי, v. infra). Ib. 51
<sup>a</sup> שאניתני (Ms. M. שאֲנַנְתָּנִי, fr. אָנַן; Mish. IV, 2 שאֹונִיתָנִי, v. אֹונָאָה, Ms. R. 1 שהֹונִיתָנִי, v. הֹונָאָה, Ms. R. 2 שאונתני, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note).</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>

<senses>
<sense>

<italic>to be overreached</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. 49
<sup>b</sup> מי נ' which of them has been overreached? Ib. 50

<entry id="A02224">
<head-word>(אניגורין) אֶנִּיגָרֹון</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (ἐλαιόγαρον, נ corrupt. for ל) 
<italic>a sauce of oil and garum</italic> (to which wine is sometimes added).</definition>

<italic>elaiogarum</italic>? Tosef. Bets. II, 16 א' ואכסיגרון ועליהן וכ' (Y. Bets. II, end, 61
<sup>d</sup> אינגורין ובתוכן וכ', corr. acc.; cmp. Rashi to Shebu. l. c.). Tosef. Ter. IX, 10; 12; Shebi. VI, 3. Koh. R. to I, 18 אגרטין (corr. acc.).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="A02229">
<head-word>אֲנִינָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (אָנַן) 
<italic>grief, retired mourning</italic>, esp. the status of the mourner between death and burial of a kinsman, contrad. to אֲבֵילָה, אֲבֵילוּת.</definition>
<notes> Lam. R. introd. (R. Abbahu 4) א' מבפנים 
<italic>ăninah</italic> is indoor (retired) grief. Y. Hor. III, 48
<sup>a</sup> top איזהו א' וכ' what is 
<italic>ăninah?</italic>—The time from death to &c. Y. Pes. VII, 35
<sup>a</sup> top אֲנִינַת לילה תורה observance of ăninah by night is biblical. Gen. R. s. 85 he is named 
<italic>Onan</italic> שהביא א' לעצמו because he brought mourning over his early death.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<italic>such an agreement forced upon a Jew by a gentile</italic> (
<italic>Roman</italic>) 
<italic>individual or authority</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gitt. 44
<sup>a</sup> (v. אָנַס) אם בא' if his crop was seized in consequence of an 
<italic>anparuth</italic>, he is exempt from paying the tithes (of his produces, since he is the loser, whereas if distrained for a real debt, he enjoys the legal benefit of being released of a debt, and therefore must pay the tithes, as if he had sold the crop). Y. Keth. X, end, 34
<sup>a</sup> בארנונה וכ' with reference to annona, capitation tax and forfeiture. Gitt. 58
<sup>b</sup> הבא מחמת חוב ומחמת א' וכ' if a gentile (Roman) obtained possession of a Jew’s property in consequence of seizure for a debt or of forfeiture and subsequently sold it to a Jew, the Sicarion law finds no application (and the property must, without any indemnity, be restored to its original owner; v. סִיקְרִיקֹון); וא' עצמה וכ' and the property seized for forfeiture must have been in the possession of the gentile for twelve months (during which the Jew might have had a chance to reclaim it as illegally seized; v., however, the objection, and subsequent emendation of סיקריקין for א', ibid.). Ib. אין א' בבבל in Babylon (under the Persian government) there is no 
<italic>anparuth</italic>, (which is interpreted) אין דין א' וכ' the laws concerning the purchase by a Jew of property which a gentile had seized for forfeiture find no application in the well regulated Persian state because the owner might have gone to court, if he felt himself aggrieved. Tosef. Gitt. V (III), 2.—
<plural-form>Pl. אַנְפָּרִיֹּות</plural-form>. Y’lamd. Sh’laḥ. (quot. in Ar.) אני נוטל מהן א' וכ' I (the Lord) take from them promises to pay in instalments (promises of amending their ways, repentance) and give them extension. Tanḥ. ib., end, a citizen was paying 
<italic>annonæ</italic> וכותב א' and signing agreements of forfeiture; (Num. R. s. 17 אפכיות, v. אַפּוּכִי). [Ibid. s. 2 אנפריאות, v. אַנְפֹּורָא pl.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<head-word>אִסְטוֹלָא, </head-word>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (Ispe. noun of טל, טלל; cmp. טַלִּית) 
<italic>robe, garment</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. Gen. IX, 23; a. fr.—Sabb. 128
<sup>a</sup> א' הראוייה לו a robe becoming his position. M. Kat. 28
<sup>b</sup> (prov.) שיול א' וכ' the grave is a fine robe for the freeman whose outfit is complete (well becoming old and virtuous age). B. Mets. 17
<sup>a</sup>; a. e.—
<plural-form>Pl. אִסְטְלִין, אִסְטְלֵי, אִסְטַלְוָון, אִצְ'</plural-form> &c. א' דלבושין 
<italic>a suit of clothes</italic>. Targ. Gen. XLV, 22; (ed. Berl. אוּסְטְלַוָּן; ib. Y. אסטלוי ולבוש, read אסטלי דלבוש).—Y. Ber. III, 6
<sup>d</sup> bot. (v. margin. note ed. Krot.). M. Kat. 24
<sup>a</sup>. Y. Snh. X, 29
<sup>b</sup>. Koh. R. to XI, 1 א' דלבושן v. supra.—Cmp. אִסְטַלִּית.—[Y. Shek. III, 47
<sup>c</sup> bot. אסטלי של זהב, read אִיסְטְרֵי; v. אִיסְתִּירָא.] [Although our w. coincides, in meaning and sound, with στολή in its poëtic and older sense as ‘an outfit’, yet the form of its Hebrew equivalent (אסטלית) and the laws regulating the borrowing of words, as well as its appearance in so remote a dialect as the Mandaic (as עצטלא) forbid the derivation from the Greek.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>
